summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K dated September 28, 2026, updating its ongoing share repurchase program. The Danish issuer repurchased 1,205,000 B shares from September 21 to September 25, 2026, at prices ranging from DKK 250.42 to DKK 267.41, spending roughly DKK 309.9 million. The program, initiated May 6, 2026, authorizes up to DKK 11.2 billion in repurchases through February 1, 2027, part of a broader DKK 15 billion 12-month plan. Treasury shares now total 49,419,876 B shares, or 1.1% of capital.
